# Project readiness checklist

## Before implementation
- [ ] Owner's complete application prompt received
- [ ] Target users, languages, and supported regions confirmed
- [ ] Customer and admin journeys documented
- [ ] Medicine catalog source, ownership, and update process confirmed
- [ ] Inventory and price authority confirmed
- [ ] Delivery coverage, fees, and operational process confirmed
- [ ] Payment methods and actual provider availability confirmed
- [ ] Contact channels and notification requirements confirmed
- [ ] Privacy, retention, and access requirements confirmed
- [ ] Hosting, domain, budget, and operational ownership confirmed
- [ ] Architecture and acceptance criteria approved by owner

## Before release
- [ ] Build and tests run with recorded results
- [ ] Search, product detail, cart, checkout, account, and order status verified where in scope
- [ ] Admin permissions and inventory/price updates verified
- [ ] Arabic and English content/layout verified where in scope
- [ ] Mobile responsiveness and accessibility reviewed
- [ ] Security and dependency review completed
- [ ] External integrations tested against real providers; placeholders clearly labelled
- [ ] Backup, rollback, and environment configuration documented
- [ ] Production URL opened and smoke-tested
- [ ] Known issues and limitations disclosed
- [ ] Owner accepts handover

## Evidence standard
For each checked item, record the method, environment, date, result, and evidence. If a check could not be run, mark it **not verified**, not passed.
